description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade controller class within the Opencart admin tool, responsible for handling the upgrade process, including checking for latest version, downloading upgrade files, and installing updates.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class for managing the upgrade process in the OpenCart admin area, including checking for updates, downloading, and applying updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the upgrade page with version info, fetches latest upgrade info from server, and prepares the view.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading the specified version of OpenCart as a ZIP file from GitHub for upgrade purposes.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Unzips the downloaded upgrade package and copies files to the installation directory to perform the upgrade.
